resources.string: KinSync now notices a few more things. Please read what it does and agree again to keep it running.
KinSync quietly checks that your day looks normal for you. To do that, it notices:
When you unlock your phone and when the screen turns on or off
Which apps you use and for how long
When your phone last moved (no step counting, no location)
Whether you are still, walking or in a vehicle

All of this stays on this phone, and you can see it in the app. KinSync never reads what you type, never listens, and never tracks where you go. Only a simple \"I\'m okay\" signal will ever be sent to your family. You can turn this off at any time.
KinSync is off. Nothing is being collected. You can agree above whenever you are ready.

Android requires a special permission called \"Usage access\" before an app can help notice your daily patterns. KinSync only uses this to recognize when your phone is being used — it does not read any content.

To make sure KinSync can\'t be silently stopped by battery optimization, please allow it to run in the background. This does not mean the app runs wastefully — it only wakes briefly when your screen turns on or off.
